title: Eleven sustain gunshot wounds in shooting near Florida university
summary_full: Police said an altercation at a homecoming party escalated into gunfire, resulting in six adults and six juveniles injuredA shooting ⁠near a Florida university campus in Tallahassee has left 11 people ⁠with gunshot wounds ⁠and ​another person injured, authorities say.The shooting took place near the Florida Agricultural + Mechanical University’s campus ⁠on Perry Street on Saturday night, the university said, while police counted six adults and six ⁠juveniles among the injured.
